Entries.FairySeeds_Description: Kuzda eking. Sirli gul hosil bo‘lishiga 12 kun ketadi. Turli ranglarda.
Entries.FairyStone_Description: Qadimiy konchilar qo‘shig‘ida aytilishicha, bular qadimgi parilarning suyaklaridan yasalgan.
Entries.FarAwayStone_Description: Kelib chiqishi noma’lum tosh. Uni nimaningdir ichiga joylashtirish mumkindek ko‘rinadi.
Entries.FarmersLunch_Description: Bu sizga ishni davom ettirishga kuch beradi.
Entries.FiberSeeds_Description: Istalgan faslda eking. Sug‘orish shart emas. O‘roq bilan yig‘ib oling. O‘sishiga 7 kun ketadi.
Entries.FiddleheadFern_Description: Yosh novdalari iste’mol qilinadigan tansiq mahsulotdir.
Entries.FiddleheadRisotto_Description: Qovurilgan qirqquloq novdalari bilan tortiladigan qaymoqli guruch taomi. Biroz bemaza.
Entries.FieldSnack_Description: Och qolgan yig‘uvchiga tezda kuch beradigan yegulik.
Entries.FireOpal_Description: Qizil dog‘lari tufayli shunday atalgan noyob opal turi.
Entries.FireQuartz_Description: Odatda qaynoq lava yaqinida topiladigan qizil nurli kristall.
Entries.FireworksGreen_Description: Bayram va tantanalarning qadimiy an’anasi. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlating!
Entries.FireworksPurple_Description: Bayram va tantanalarning qadimiy an’anasi. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlating!
Entries.FireworksRed_Description: Bayram va tantanalarning qadimiy an’anasi. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlating!
Entries.FishStew_Description: Hidi dengiznikiga juda o‘xshaydi. Ammo ta’mi yaxshiroq.
Entries.Flounder_Description: U suv tubida yashaydi, shuning uchun ikkala ko‘zi ham boshining tepasida joylashgan.
Entries.Fluorapatite_Description: Uning oz miqdori inson tishlarida uchraydi.
Entries.FossilizedRibs_Description: Qadim zamonlarda bu qovurg‘alar yirik hayvonning tanasini himoya qilgan.
Entries.FossilizedTail_Description: Bu dumning uchida gurziga o‘xshash qism bor.
Entries.FossilStone_Description: Qazilma qoldiqlar va suyaklar olish uchun parchalab tashlang.
